## Architecture Overview

The `Data` field on `corev1.Secret` is `map[string][]byte`. Changing to a named type `SecretData` breaks all code that directly indexes (`secret.Data[key]`), assigns (`secret.Data[key] = value`), initializes (`make(map[string][]byte)`), or deletes from the map.

## Detailed Analysis

### Helm

- **`pkg/storage/driver/secrets.go`** (lines 79, 104, 146) — `obj.Data["release"]` and `item.Data["release"]`. Stores/retrieves encoded Helm release data.

### ArgoCD

- **`util/db/secrets.go`** (lines 50, 59, 68-81) — Read `secret.Data[key]` in helpers (`boolOrFalse`, `intOrZero`), write `secret.Data[key] = []byte(...)`.
- **`util/db/repository_secrets.go`** (lines 418-419, 229, 294) — `secret.Data = make(map[string][]byte)`, reads repository credentials.
- **`util/settings/accounts.go`** (lines 171-305) — Reads/writes account passwords, tokens from Secret.Data.
- **`util/db/cluster.go`** (line 199) — `secret.Data["server"]` for cluster config.
- **`util/settings/settings.go`** (lines 1657-1658) — TLS cert/key from Secret.Data.
- **`common/common.go`** (lines 490, 494) — Redis credentials from Secret.Data.
- **`util/clusterauth/clusterauth.go`** (lines 239, 250) — Service account token from Secret.Data.

### Cert-Manager

- **`pkg/controller/certificates/issuing/secret_manager.go`** — Direct writes `secret.Data[key] = []byte(...)`.
- **`pkg/controller/certificates/issuing/internal/secret.go`** (lines 61-71, 261-364) — Reads `secret.Data[corev1.TLSCertKey]`, writes PKCS12/JKS keystores.

### External-Secrets

- **`pkg/controllers/externalsecret/externalsecret_controller.go`** (lines 486-508) — `secret.Data = make(map[string][]byte)`, `delete(secret.Data, key)`.
- **`pkg/controllers/pushsecret/pushsecret_controller.go`** (lines 435, 461) — `secret.Data = secretData`, `secret.Data[key]`.

## Relevant Files

| Repo | File Path | Why |
|------|-----------|-----|
| helm | pkg/storage/driver/secrets.go | Data["release"] indexing |
| argo-cd | util/db/secrets.go | Data[key] read/write helpers |
| argo-cd | util/db/repository_secrets.go | make(map[string][]byte) and credential reads |
| argo-cd | util/settings/accounts.go | Password/token read/write from Data |
| argo-cd | util/db/cluster.go | Data["server"] for cluster config |
| argo-cd | util/settings/settings.go | TLS cert/key from Data |
| argo-cd | util/clusterauth/clusterauth.go | SA token from Data |
| cert-manager | pkg/controller/certificates/issuing/secret_manager.go | Direct Data writes |
| cert-manager | pkg/controller/certificates/issuing/internal/secret.go | TLS cert/key/keystore reads and writes |
| external-secrets | pkg/controllers/externalsecret/externalsecret_controller.go | make(), delete(), Data[] operations |
| external-secrets | pkg/controllers/pushsecret/pushsecret_controller.go | Data assignment and indexing |
